description: (Na)₂LiDyCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a LiDyCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the LiDyCl₆ framework, Li is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form LiCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent DyCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Li-Cl bond lengths are 2.52 Å. Dy is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form DyCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent LiCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Dy-Cl bond lengths are 2.61 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Li and one Dy atom.
